en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a small European town set in hilly countryside. In the foreground are sheds or greenhouse roofs and gardens. Behind them stand neat, steep‑roofed houses with dormer windows, surrounded by many trees. Dominating the middle distance is a large church with a tall Baroque-style tower and spire rising above adjoining buildings that resemble a monastery or large institutional complex. Rolling hills form the backdrop under a clear sky. There is no visible printed title or caption on the image.
